ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $C$ is a point on the semicircle $O$ with $AB$ as its diameter. Connect $AC$ and $BC$. Construct squares $ACDE$ and $BCFG$ externally on sides $AC$ and $BC$, respectively. Let $M$, $N$, $P$, and $Q$ be the midpoints of $DE$, $FG$, arc $AC$, and arc $BC$, respectively. If $MP + NQ = 14$ and $AC + BC = 18$, what is the length of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect OP and OQ which intersect AC and BC at points I and H respectively,\\
$\because$ The midpoints of DE, FG, $\overset{\frown}{AC}$, and $\overset{\frown}{BC}$ are M, N, P, and Q respectively,\\
$\therefore$ OP $\perp$ AC, OQ $\perp$ BC,\\
$\therefore$ H and I are the midpoints of AC and BD,\\
$\therefore$ OH+OI=$\frac{1}{2}$(AC+BC)=9,\\
$\therefore$ MH+NI=AC+BC=18, MP+NQ=14,\\
$\therefore$ PH+QI=18−14=4,\\
$\therefore$ AB=OP+OQ=OH+OI+PH+QI=9+4=\boxed{13},

Reasoning: Draw auxiliary lines OP and OQ. Since P and Q are respectively the midpoints of arc AC and arc BC, OP perpendicularly bisects chord AC, and OQ perpendicularly bisects chord BC. Let OP intersect AC at I, and OQ intersect BC at H; then I and H are respectively the midpoints of AC and BC. Since M and N are the midpoints of the far sides of the outside squares, in the directions perpendicular to AC and BC there are MI = AC and NH = BC, so MI + NH = AC + BC = 18. method.method_draft: Use an auxiliary-line synthetic decomposition. From the image, note that AB is the horizontal diameter of the semicircle with center O, C lies on the arc, the squares ACDE and BCFG are drawn outward, M and N are midpoints of the outer square sides DE and FG, and P and Q are the midpoints of arcs AC and BC. From the text, use MP + NQ = 14 and AC + BC = 18. Draw OP and OQ. Since P and Q are arc midpoints, OP is perpendicular to chord AC and OQ is perpendicular to chord BC, and each radius line bisects its chord. Let OP meet AC at I and OQ meet BC at H. Because M and N are midpoints of the outer sides of the squares, MI equals AC and NH equals BC along the same perpendicular directions. Thus MI + NH = AC + BC = 18. Since MP + NQ = 14 and P, Q lie between the square-midpoints and the chord-midpoints as shown, the leftover inner arc-midpoint distances satisfy PI + QH = 18 - 14 = 4. Also, in the right triangle ABC, the distance from O to chord AC plus the distance from O to chord BC is half of AC + BC, so OI + OH = 9. Therefore AB = OP + OQ = (OI + OH) + (PI + QH) = 9 + 4 = 13.

method.method_draft: Use a chord-length/sagitta algebra method. From the image, identify AB as the diameter, C as a point on the upper semicircle, and P and Q as the midpoints of arcs AC and BC; M and N are the midpoints of the external square sides, so MP and NQ measure square-side offsets minus circular sagittas. Let a = AC, b = BC, and d = AB. From the text, a + b = 18 and MP + NQ = 14. Since C lies on the semicircle with diameter AB, triangle ABC is right, so d^2 = a^2 + b^2. For chord AC, the radius through arc midpoint P meets AC at its midpoint; the distance from O to chord AC is b/2, because the radius is d/2 and half the chord is a/2. Hence the sagitta from chord AC to arc midpoint P is d/2 - b/2 = (d - b)/2. The square midpoint M is distance a from the midpoint of AC on the same perpendicular side, so MP = a - (d - b)/2. Similarly, NQ = b - (d - a)/2. Add the two equations: MP + NQ = a + b - d + (a + b)/2 = 3(a + b)/2 - d. Substitute a + b = 18 and MP + NQ = 14 to get 14 = 27 - d, so d = AB = 13.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中 AB 是水平直径，O 在 AB 上为圆心，C 位于以 AB 为直径的上半圆上；AC、BC 分别连成三角形 ABC 的两条斜边边段。在线段 AC 外侧作正方形 ACDE，DE 的中点标为 M；在线段 BC 外侧作正方形 BCFG，FG 的中点标为 N。P、Q 分别标在半圆上对应弧 AC、弧 BC 的中点位置。
推理：令 AC = a，BC = b，AB = d。已知 a + b = 18，MP + NQ = 14。因为 C 在以 AB 为直径的半圆上，由泰勒斯定理，∠ACB = 90°，所以 d 是直角三角形 ABC 的斜边。对弦 AC，过弧 AC 中点 P 的半径垂直平分 AC；O 到弦 AC 的距离等于 b/2，圆半径为 d/2，所以弦 AC 到弧中点 P 的弓高为 d/2 - b/2 = (d - b)/2。正方形 ACDE 中，DE 的中点 M 到 AC 中点的距离等于边长 a，因此 MP = a - (d - b)/2。类似地，对弦 BC，有 NQ = b - (d - a)/2。相加得 MP + NQ = a + b - [(d - b) + (d - a)]/2 = 3(a + b)/2 - d。代入 a + b = 18 和 MP + NQ = 14，得 14 = 27 - d，所以 d = 13。因此 AB = 13。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $C$ is a point on the semicircle $O$ with $AB$ as its diameter. Connect $AC$ and $BC$. Construct squares $ACDE$ and $BCFG$ externally on sides $AC$ and $BC$, respectively. Let $M$, $N$, $P$, and $Q$ be the midpoints of $DE$, $FG$, arc $AC$, and arc $BC$, respectively. If $MP + NQ = 14$ and $AC + BC = 18$, what is the length of $AB$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect OP and OQ which intersect AC and BC at points I and H respectively,\\
$\because$ The midpoints of DE, FG, $\overset{\frown}{AC}$, and $\overset{\frown}{BC}$ are M, N, P, and Q respectively,\\
$\therefore$ OP $\perp$ AC, OQ $\perp$ BC,\\
$\therefore$ H and I are the midpoints of AC and BD,\\
$\therefore$ OH+OI=$\frac{1}{2}$(AC+BC)=9,\\
$\therefore$ MH+NI=AC+BC=18, MP+NQ=14,\\
$\therefore$ PH+QI=18-14=4,\\
$\therefore$ AB=OP+OQ=OH+OI+PH+QI=9+4=\boxed{13},
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, AB is the horizontal diameter, O is on AB and is the center of the semicircle, the semicircle is above AB, and C is on the arc of the semicircle. After connecting AC and BC, construct square ACDE on the outside of AC, and construct square BCFG on the outside of BC. M is located at the midpoint of the outer side DE of square ACDE, and N is located at the midpoint of the outer side FG of square BCFG; P and Q are respectively on arc AC and arc BC, indicating the midpoints of the corresponding arcs.

Reasoning: Draw auxiliary lines OP and OQ. Since P and Q are respectively the midpoints of arc AC and arc BC, OP perpendicularly bisects chord AC, and OQ perpendicularly bisects chord BC. Let OP intersect AC at I, and OQ intersect BC at H; then I and H are respectively the midpoints of AC and BC. Since M and N are the midpoints of the far sides of the outside squares, in the directions perpendicular to AC and BC there are MI = AC and NH = BC, so MI + NH = AC + BC = 18. Also, in the figure P is on segment MI and Q is on segment NH, therefore MP + NQ = (MI - PI) + (NH - QH) = 14, so PI + QH = 18 - 14 = 4. On the other hand, in right triangle ABC, O is the midpoint of hypotenuse AB, and I and H are respectively the midpoints of AC and BC, therefore OI = BC/2 and OH = AC/2, so OI + OH = (AC + BC)/2 = 9. Since P and Q are on the semicircle with O as the center, OP = OQ = AB/2, so AB = OP + OQ = (OI + PI) + (OH + QH) = (OI + OH) + (PI + QH) = 9 + 4 = 13.
